items.title: Percy Stovall Interview, 1977-12-27
items.q: King Cole was famous then. We had his trill in there.

ctx.x: Well, we had most of all the famous stuff at that time. King Cole was famous then. We had his trill in there. Charles Brown was famous. We had his trill in there. We had another group called Cat in the Field. They was famous in those times. Cat in the Field, yeah. Uh-huh. Lou Mel Morgan, he had a trill. See, we only had trill because the place was small, you see. Right.
How many people would it exist?
